description.value: Bufala River District is a full-service Napolitana-style pizzeria set in Vancouver's newer River District neighbourhood, part of a small multi-location group that has earned consistent accolades across the city. Pizzas are scratch-made and fired in an 800-degree stone oven alongside Italian small plates, brunch on weekends, and a full bar with cocktails, craft beers, and espresso. Walk-ins are welcomed and free parking including EV stalls is available on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's River District page (/aboutbrd) confirms the phone number (604) 423-9594, email riverdistrict@bufala.ca, and address 3489 E Sawmill Cres, Vancouver, BC V5S 0E3 — all consistent with OSM. Takeout is explicitly advertised via Skip the Dishes, Door Dash, and an Order Takeout button; the menu pages mark dishes [PB] PLANT BASED, [GF] GLUTEN FREE, and [DF] DAIRY FREE confirming dietary options. No bike rack, water refill, Wi-Fi, device charging, or pump is mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address field omits the 'E' directional prefix — should be '3489 E Sawmill Crescent' per the website's River District contact block.

Website footer and some subpages display 5395 West Boulevard (Kerrisdale location) as a default address; the River District-specific page correctly shows 3489 E Sawmill Cres, so this appears to be a site-wide footer default rather than an error with this listing.
EV car parking is advertised ('Free Parking & Electric Vehicle Parking Available') but no e-bike charging infrastructure is mentioned; these should not be conflated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, open full-service restaurant with confirmed contact details and a current menu; a useful food and drink stop for touring cyclists in the River District.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu pages use [PB] PLANT BASED, [GF] GLUTEN FREE, and [DF] DAIRY FREE labels on multiple dishes; menu notes 'please notify us of any dietary restrictions and their severity.'
